title: Ikigai Isn't
<g>Four Circles</g>
subtitle: That famous Venn maps hatarakigai, a reason for working.

cards.title: A felt sense
cards.body: Mieko Kamiya called it ikigai-kan, the lived sense that life is worth living.

cards.title: Many small reasons
cards.body: Not one grand purpose. A tapestry, not a thread.

cards.title: Found in ordinary moments
cards.body: The morning tea. The cat in the warmest chair.
